details.description:
Rasna presents advanced Ayurveda Chyawanprash that contains 10 immunity boosters and a special Avaleha that helps you stay healthy. Chyawanprashs are popular in Indian households for the myriad of health benefits they offer. This nutritious herbal supplement is prepared with 53 Ayurvedic ingredients that support your immune system and improve overall health.
The 10 immunity boosters include Aamla, Cinnamon, Kesar, Guduchi, Vidarikand, Gokshura, Punarnava, and Shalparni. Each has different benefits from boosting and building a stronger immunity to helping in digestion, managing bronchitis, protecting kidneys and heart, relieving constipation, and even controlling diabetes.
details.ingredients: Bilva, Aganimantha, Shyonaka, Gambhari, Patala, Madgaparni, Masparni, Shalparni, Prishniparni, Pippali, Gokshura, Kantakari, Brihati, Karkatshringi, Bhumi Amalki, Draksha, Jivanti, Pushkarmool, Agaru, Guduchi, Haritaki, Bala, Riddhi, Vriddhi, Jivaka, Rishabhak, Karchur, Mustak, Punarnava, Meda, Mahmeda, Elaichi, Kamal Pushpa, Shweta Chandan, Vidarikand, Vasa, Kakoli, Kshir Kakoli, Kaknasika, Amlakali, Ghee Sharkara, Kesar. Immunity Boosters- Pipal, Tvak Elaichi, Tvakpatra, Nagkesara, Lavang Vansalochan, Shukti Bhasma, Makardhwaj, Chandi Varakh. Sodium Benzoate.
details.usageInstructions:
For adults - One teaspoonful (Appx.12 g) twice a day.
For children (3-12 Yrs Old) - Half teaspoonful (Appx.6g) twice a day.
